mathematical_sources.note: The source poses the infinitude question. Priority and novelty have not been established by a comprehensive literature search and are not claimed.

mathematical_sources.note: The agent found this manuscript on GitHub during the final stage of formalization and used its exposition to guide the r0 = 20 weight, arithmetic side conditions, full-cell proxies and parameter order. Guo did not participate in the project or provide personal assistance. Earlier work pursued the same fixed-shift strategy from the common OpenAI sources. The broader shift, parity, squarefreeness and quantitative claims in this paper are not all formalized here. The retained source was hash-checked; the original URL returned 404 on 2026-11-12. See ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md for the exact source identity.
